$comment: These lists follow 国际中文教育中文水平等级标准 (GF0025-2021). The standard grades levels 7-9 as a single band (高等), so the split of that band into levels 7, 8 and 9 in hsk30_level does not come from the standard. The HSK 3.0 exam that launches on 13 December 2026 follows the 2025 examination syllabus instead.
